items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: Another boy named George Brown, he was a trumpet player. And we had a fella play with us during that time called Jack Molasses... And I played drums then with them.

ctx.x: Woodford. Uh, yeah, it's, it's spelled the same as Versace. Woodford County. Um, do you remember anybody in Sam Clark's band?
Yeah, there's, uh, Fessal Mack. He was a trumpet player. George Brown.
Was that the fella they called Red Mack later? Or Shorty Mack?
